source_snapshot.criteria: Network >80% of bandwidth, stable load and no SEL error.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY; adds safe FIO targets, exact concurrency, per-domain evidence and recovery.

old_problem: Pending inputs were topology, safe targets, workload matrix and per-domain limits; the concurrent full-load method is otherwise well defined.
disposition_reason: ED-03 binds topology/tools, ED-04 protects storage, ED-05 preserves each Ethernet path, ED-09 keeps chamber/cabling work manual, ED-14 preserves exact concurrent duration, and ED-15 keeps the per-path 80% oracle signed.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX row49 all 18 columns, same-row DeepSeek, history3085 and actual next row50/history3086 were read.
All eight NIC paths, approved FIO targets, GPUs and DIMMs must overlap for the entire 12-hour interval; separate runs lose contention coverage.
OS, mounted, RAID, unknown or valuable storage is excluded unless explicitly authorized and protected.
Per-path and per-target evidence prevents aggregate load from hiding a weak domain; no stress ran.

test_case.test_name: Concurrent eight-NIC, storage, GPU and DIMM load for 12 hours at 0C/+5%
test_case.purpose: Verify the full platform sustains the signed concurrent workload matrix at cold/high-rail margin with each NIC above its approved 80% floor and no data, link, accelerator, memory or platform fault.
required_package: GPU/DIMM identities, tools and load floors
Exact overlap plus environmental/per-domain abort and recovery profile
test_case.test_command: Qualified staff establish dry 0C/+5% conditions and run the approved eight-path network, safe FIO, GPU and memory profiles in one exact 12-hour overlap while recording per-domain health, then clean up, warm dry and restore nominal state.
test_case.expected_result: Every workload remains within signed load/performance/integrity limits for the full overlap; each NIC exceeds its own 80% floor and no disallowed data, XID/ECC/AER/RAS/SEL event occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact concurrency, all eight paths and all authorized targets for 12 hours. Aggregate throughput, staggered jobs, unsafe disks or a short smoke test cannot pass.
safety_gate: Immutable storage identities and OS/mount/RAID/data protection
Abort on data, link, XID/ECC/AER/RAS, thermal/power, heartbeat or moisture fault
No auto-retry; cleanup and dry warm-up
expected_evidence: Per-target FIO integrity/SMART-NVMe and GPU/DIMM health
test_case.recovery: Stop all domains coherently on a limit, preserve correlated evidence, protect/quarantine affected storage, restore nominal rails, warm/dry, restore topology/services and do not auto-retry.
